pharm: GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator with anticonvulsant, anxiolytic and sedative properties
quick: Weight-based: <=30 kg up to 20 mg/day; >30 kg up to 40 mg/day
Take with or without food (oral suspension and tablets)
Risk of neonatal sedation/withdrawal; use only if benefit justifies risk
Present in milk; monitor infant for sedation/poor feeding
No specific adjustment in mild-moderate impairment
Reduce dose in mild-moderate impairment; no data for severe
Sedation, respiratory depression, mood/suicidality, skin reactions
summary: Clobazam is a 1,5-benzodiazepine indicated as adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome in patients aged 2 years and older. It carries a boxed warning for risks with concomitant opioids, and for abuse, misuse, addiction, dependence and withdrawal. It is habit forming (Schedule IV controlled substance).
indications: Adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age or older

dosage.d: Start 5 mg/day; day 7: 10 mg/day; day 14: up to 20 mg/day
dosage.n: Doses >5 mg/day given in two divided doses

dosage.d: Start 10 mg/day; day 7: 20 mg/day; day 14: up to 40 mg/day
dosage.n: Do not escalate faster than weekly

dosage.c: Geriatric / CYP2C19 poor metaboliser / hepatic impairment
dosage.d: Lower starting dose and slower titration

admin: Doses above 5 mg/day are given in two divided doses; 5 mg/day may be a single dose
Tablets may be given whole, broken in half, or crushed and mixed in applesauce
Shake oral suspension well; use only the provided oral dosing syringe
May be taken with or without food
Do not stop abruptly - taper to avoid withdrawal and seizures
moa: Clobazam is a 1,5-benzodiazepine. Its anticonvulsant action is thought to involve potentiation of GABAergic neurotransmission by binding at the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor, enhancing chloride conductance and neuronal inhibition.

absolute: History of hypersensitivity to clobazam or its ingredients (including serious dermatological reactions)
relative: Concomitant opioids or other CNS depressants

preg: Clobazam use during pregnancy can result in neonatal sedation and/or neonatal withdrawal syndrome. Use during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk. Encourage enrolment in the pregnancy registry.
lact: Clobazam is present in human milk. Breastfed infants should be monitored for sedation, poor feeding and poor weight gain. Consider the benefits of breastfeeding alongside the mother's clinical need and potential infant risk.
renal: No specific dosage adjustment is recommended for mild-to-moderate renal impairment; there are limited data in severe impairment/ESRD.
hepatic: Clobazam is hepatically metabolised; reduce the dose in mild-to-moderate (Child-Pugh A-B) hepatic impairment. No information is available for severe impairment.

major: Opioids - profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, death (boxed warning)
Other CNS depressants (alcohol, benzodiazepines, sedatives) - additive depression
moderate: Strong CYP2C19 inhibitors - increase active metabolite (N-desmethylclobazam) levels
Hormonal contraceptives - clobazam may reduce contraceptive efficacy (use additional method)
minor: CYP3A4 inducers may modestly reduce clobazam levels
interactions.food: May be taken with or without food
interactions.alcohol: Avoid - markedly increases CNS and respiratory depression
interactions.diagnostics: CYP2C19 genotype affects metabolism; poor metabolisers need lower doses

rare: Serious dermatological reactions (Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis)

monitoring: Sedation and respiratory status (especially with opioids)
Suicidal thoughts or behaviour and mood changes
Skin reactions, especially in the first 8 weeks
counsel: Do not drink alcohol or use other sedatives/opioids without medical advice
Do not stop suddenly - the dose must be tapered to avoid withdrawal and seizures
This medicine can be habit forming; take exactly as prescribed
Report any rash, blistering, or facial swelling immediately
Watch for new or worsening depression or suicidal thoughts; use additional contraception
pk: Anticonvulsant effect over days as steady state is reached
Plasma Tmax 0.5-4 hours; active metabolite peaks later
Store at 20-25 C; keep secured (controlled substance)
pearls: Habit forming: Yes - Schedule IV controlled benzodiazepine
Boxed warning: opioid co-use, abuse/addiction, dependence/withdrawal
Always taper; abrupt stop can precipitate status epilepticus
CYP2C19 poor metabolisers and hepatic impairment need lower doses
May reduce efficacy of hormonal contraceptives
missed: Take the missed dose as soon as remembered. If it is close to the next dose, skip the missed dose; never take two doses together. Do not stop the medicine without tapering.
overdose: Overdose causes excessive CNS depression - somnolence, confusion, ataxia, respiratory depression and coma, worsened by alcohol/other depressants. Provide supportive care with airway/ventilation support; flumazenil may reverse benzodiazepine effects but can precipitate seizures and is used with caution.
